meta.title: Dimi's Lessons
meta.description: A calm place for lessons, homework, and payments.

welcome.devHint: Teacher sign-in for this copy: dimi@lessons.app

auth.signInLead: Teachers and parents use an email and a password. Students use the name and PIN from their teacher.
auth.chooseLead: This is the password you will use next time.
auth.demoLead: Practice accounts, so you can look around.
auth.invalid: That email and password don't match.
auth.sentLead: Open it to finish signing in. It expires in 30 minutes.
auth.unknown: No account uses that email yet.
auth.expired: That link has expired. Request a new one.
auth.studentLead: Your name, as your teacher wrote it, and the PIN they gave you.
auth.name: Name

register.title: Who will study
register.lead: Fill this in for the student. If they pay for themselves, say so. Otherwise add the first parent.
register.privacy: Your teacher and the parents linked to this student can see what you send.
register.paysSelfLead: Turn this on when they handle their own lessons. A second parent can be linked later.
register.parentLead: The person who pays. A second parent can be linked to the same student afterwards.
register.teacherCodeHint: Six digits from your teacher. An invitation link fills this in.
register.occupationHint: A field or a job, whichever is easier.
register.subject: Subject
register.thanksLead: When your teacher confirms it, you will get an email to choose a password.

today.title: My students
today.lengthLead: One hour, an hour and a half, two hours, or any other length.
today.emptyLead: Add the first student. A lesson after that is one tap.
today.emptyArchiveLead: Students you are no longer teaching will wait here.

money.title: Who to reach
money.emptyLead: No student is running low on lessons or hours.
money.noPayer: No one is linked yet. Open the student and link the person who pays.
money.noContact: No phone or email on this profile.

client.name: Name
client.subject: Subject
client.suggestLesson: Suggested from the agreed {price} per lesson.
client.suggestHour: Suggested from the agreed {price} per hour.
client.dealLead: Note whether the new deal is per lesson or per hour, and what the new price is.
client.archiveLead: They leave My students and wait in the archive.
client.restoreLead: They come back to My students.
client.pinHint: Four to six digits. The student uses this with their name. Leave blank to keep the current PIN.
client.removeParentLead: They stop seeing this student's lessons. Their own account stays.
client.question: Open question
client.needParent: Link a parent before you can ask for feedback.
client.materialsEmpty: What you covered in the lesson
client.linkAnotherLead: This sits apart from the people already linked to this student.
client.setPrice: Add a price per lesson so an open balance can be calculated.
client.removeStudentConfirm: Remove this student, their lessons, and their payments?

signups.title: Waiting for you
signups.emptyLead: When a parent fills in the form, it will land here.
signups.inviteLead: Share the link, or the code beside it in Settings. The link fills the code into the form.
signups.otherParentLead: Someone asked to be linked with a student code. Nothing opens until you accept.

join.title: Join a student
join.lead: Enter the student's code, plus your name and email. The teacher confirms it before you can see the lessons.
join.privacy: Your teacher and the parents linked to this student can see what you send.
join.name: Your name
join.thanksLead: When the teacher confirms it, you will get an email to choose a password.

feedback.title: How the lessons feel
feedback.emptyLead: Ask a parent from their student's page, or wait for a note.
feedback.pendingEmptyLead: Questions you have asked, and that have not been answered yet, show up here.
feedback.restoreLead: It returns to the list it came from.
feedback.archiveLead: It leaves this list and waits in the archive. You can put it back.
feedback.noteHint: Not about one lesson. How the teaching feels overall.

settings.title: Your contact
settings.lead: Parents see your name and phone, and can tap to call.
settings.name: Name
settings.inviteLead: People can type this code, or open the link, which fills it in.

parent.title: Lessons
parent.emptyLead: When a registration is confirmed, the lessons show up here.
parent.noPhone: Your teacher has not added a phone number yet.
parent.paymentsLead: What has already come in for your students.
parent.paymentsEmptyLead: When a payment is recorded, it will be listed here.
parent.readOnly: You can look, and you can leave feedback. Lessons stay as the teacher wrote them.
parent.feedbackLead: The teacher will see this with the lesson it belongs to.

studentHome.title: Homework and what you studied
studentHome.noPhone: No phone on this profile yet.
studentHome.emptyLead: After a lesson, homework will show up on this page.
studentHome.answerAsk: What was the answer of the last task?

errors.invalidPin: Use 4 to 6 digits for the PIN.
errors.unknownCode: That code does not match a profile.

landing.title: Four years of paper notebooks, open to everyone who needs them.

chapters.name: Today
chapters.title: One tap after class.
chapters.body: Who is next, then one note: what you studied and the homework. The family sees the date before you have packed up.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.title: A ledger that stays quiet.
chapters.body: Prices, payments and prepaid packs live with the lessons. Open balances and packs running low rise to the top. When everyone is settled, the page says so.

chapters.name: Family
chapters.title: The parent reads the same page.
chapters.body: Parents see every lesson, the homework and the payments, and can leave feedback. The record stays exactly as the teacher wrote it.

chapters.name: Student
chapters.title: Homework waits under their own name.
chapters.body: A student signs in with their name and a PIN. They see what was studied and what is due, and nothing about money.

money.settled: Everyone else is up to date.

landing.filmTitle: The whole studio, in one short film.
landing.endLead: Teachers and parents sign in with email. Students use their name and PIN.
